changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: An occasion holds its exact version, or the pending fence its source stored at it. Rolling back the nullable version needs a backup once pending rows exist.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE item_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_item_event_version_or_fence CHECK (item_version IS NOT NULL OR pending_fence IS NOT NULL)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE item_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_item_event_version_or_fence

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Event facts stay immutable; an open occasion with no version may receive its exact version once.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guard_item_event_facts() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.workspace_id,NEW.item_id,NEW.name,NEW.occurred_at,NEW.found_by,NEW.pending_fence) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.workspace_id,OLD.item_id,OLD.name,OLD.occurred_at,OLD.found_by,OLD.pending_fence) OR (OLD.item_version IS NOT NULL AND NEW.item_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.item_version) OR (OLD.item_version IS NULL AND NEW.item_version IS NOT NULL AND OLD.state NOT IN ('RECORDED','WAITING')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'event facts are immutable' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guard_item_event_facts() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.workspace_id,NEW.item_id,NEW.name,NEW.item_version,NEW.occurred_at,NEW.found_by) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.workspace_id,OLD.item_id,OLD.name,OLD.item_version,OLD.occurred_at,OLD.found_by) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'event facts are immutable' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$
